entries.description: Payment orchestration REST API. One integration to accept payments across 1,000+ payment methods in 190+ countries, route transactions to the best provider, run payouts, and manage subscriptions. Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at the url.
representativeQueries: create a payment with a local payment method in a specific country
check the status of a payment by its id
create a payout to a bank account or digital wallet

entries.description: Official MCP server exposing the Yuno API as Model Context Protocol tools. Distributed as the npm package @yuno-payments/yuno-mcp and run locally by the MCP client; there is no hosted MCP endpoint.
representativeQueries: connect an AI assistant to Yuno payments over MCP
create and inspect Yuno payments from an MCP client
